text: michi 0.2.0 launches a command in 0.73 ms serially, as cheap as a bare fork+exec, but the rate does not rise with batch width: 1.3 ms per launch at 48 wide over 2,000 /bin/true, 2.25 ms at 20,000; xargs -P 48 gets 0.42. pre_exec for affinity forces fork() over posix_spawn, and fork copies the parent's page tables under the mm lock, so launches serialise and cost scales with parent RSS: cutoffs fill at 2.6 GB ran 11 a second. Measured 6 Oct 2026; the driver was scratch and is gone.
